title: Insufficient authorization in personal notification rules in Checkmk <2.5.0p20, <2.4.0p41 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows…
description: Checkmk versions prior to 2.5.0p20, 2.4.0p41, and version 2.3.0 (EOL) contain an insufficient authorization vulnerability in personal notification rules. This flaw allows authenticated users to configure broad notification rules and receive alerts for hosts and services they are not authorized contacts of.
